newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporates start expected busy week quietly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporates start expected busy week quietly.

text.p: Despite expectations of a extremely active week ahead, new issuance and secondary market trading was particularly light on Monday, market players said.
"It was very quite today. Not a heck of a lot went on and spreads were unchanged," said one trader.
As of the close of trading, prices in the investment-grade and high-yield generally tracked Treasuries.
The Treasury market was also sluggish in advance of an auction of $30.75 billion of two- and five-year notes later this week.
